findings.correction: list_recent_history, list_downloads, and list_recently_closed require the manual Catalog selector All handlers; chrome_history and chrome_recently_closed remain visible on the default Agent surface. This Catalog choice does not change agent advertisement or tool binding.

findings.original_error: The recently-closed cases instructed a Settings grant of an optional sessions permission.
findings.reviewer_error: The peer review also called sessions optional and suggested a missing Settings toggle as a product issue.
findings.correction: For Chrome, sessions is a required manifest permission. Preflight its presence in the exact loaded artifact and disposable profile; stop unverified if absent. No optional grant, Settings toggle, or product change is proposed. The handlers' required_optional_permissions metadata does not alter the manifest declaration.

findings.original_error: The procedure could read as ready before an owned completed-download fixture existed.
findings.correction: The download case is marked fixture-pending-unverified. It may be executed only after a real owned fixture is completed in the disposable profile and its filename recorded.
